question.text:
Given below are two statements :
Statements I : Acidity of \(\alpha\)-hydrogens of aldehydes and ketones is responsible for Aldol reaction. Statement II : Reaction between benzaldehyde and ethanal will NOT give Cross - Aldol product. In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below :

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct

solution.text: Aldehyde and ketones having acidic $\alpha$-hydrogen show aldol reaction
